classification_rule: Primary grouping is university level; geographically international competitions do not appear in the school International tab. Eligibility must be retained per competition/year.

records.name: William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition
records.audience: Undergraduate students without a bachelor's degree at participating institutions

paper_structure.through_2025: Session A and Session B; six A and six B problems
paper_structure.from_2026: Four 90-minute sessions with three problems each; preserve official session labels, no invented day splits

records.name: International Mathematics Competition for University Students
records.audience: Primarily students completing years 1–4 of university; age cap 23 with organiser-approved exceptions

paper_structure.note: Preserve each year's actual official day, numbering and paper structure; do not presume uniform counts

records.name: South Eastern European Mathematical Olympiad for University Students
records.audience: University students, with eligibility restrictions to be checked per edition

paper_structure.note: Original complete examinations must be recovered and classified by edition

records.name: Vojtěch Jarník International Mathematical Competition
records.audience: University students; preserve official Category I / Category II rules per edition

paper_structure.note: Category I and Category II retain official numbering; 1991 has Category I only in the official archive. Separate 4-M and 4-I alternatives retained in both categories for 1997 and 1998.

records.name: Simon Marais Mathematics Competition
records.audience: Undergraduate-level university mathematics participants; check exact team and individual eligibility per edition

paper_structure.2017_2021: Session A and B, four problems each; 2021 West used only B
paper_structure.2022_2025: Paper A, B and C, four problems each; A is East first session, B shared East second / West first, C West second
